components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Optional and kept for backward
            compatibility: a request may instead supply the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2'). When absent the server composes it from the
            structured lines. On the response it is the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When present it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            postcode range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Optional when absent; stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional on
            create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate. Optional;
            stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has
            the same last name and address (they intentionally share a household).
            Write-only; not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's id and returned.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a title is
                present, otherwise just the lastName. Derived from the owner's own fields
                and returned.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is
                the region code (derived from the postcode range, else the city table, else
                'UNKNOWN'), FY the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the
                registrationDate, HASH8 the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of
                (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK a single Luhn check digit over the digits
                of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation (de-duplicated by appending '-<n>' on
                collision) and returned.
              type: string
              example: NSW271A2B3C4D5
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A1C7E5B2D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the SHA-256 hex (64 lower-case hex
                characters) of 'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'. All
                duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a create is
                rejected (409) only when a new owner's whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's. Derived from the owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively. Assigned at
                creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of
                the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (e.g. 15 Aug 2026 yields 'FY27'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when an email is present,
                plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when
                tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from registrationDate to today)
                exceeds 1. Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created — approaching the hard
                per-city capacity limit of 50 — otherwise false. Assigned at creation
                and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner this owner may
                duplicate (same lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent otherwise.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual risk review because any of the
                following hold: the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate),
                the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares its second-level label
                with a known disposable domain, e.g. a sibling TLD such as
                'mailinator.net'), or the city is over its soft capacity
                (capacityWarning). Otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own
                fields and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table. Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality (region)
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the stored telephone and returned;
                the raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Present only when birthDate is set.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                Derived from the owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record. Deleted
                owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The flat postal address of the pet owner. Optional and kept for backward
            compatibility: a request may instead supply the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2'). When absent the server composes it from the
            structured lines. On the response it is the normalized, composed address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name).
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; normalized the same way
            (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite,
            etc.). When present it is normalized and appended, after a single space, to
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            postcode range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Optional when absent; stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional on
            create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's optional date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. When present it
            is used to derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate. Optional;
            stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has
            the same last name and address (they intentionally share a household).
            Write-only; not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's id and returned.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a title is
                present, otherwise just the lastName. Derived from the owner's own fields
                and returned.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner API contract this representation follows. Version 2
                groups the owner's identifiers under the nested 'identity' object and rederives
                each of them with the version-2 algorithm (a fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the
                same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively. Assigned at
                creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of
                the fiscal year (starting 1 July) that contains the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (e.g. 15 Aug 2026 yields 'FY27'). Derived from the owner's own
                fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starting at 0, plus 2 when an email is present,
                plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 when
                tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from registrationDate to today)
                exceeds 1. Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Derived and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration day at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created — approaching the hard
                per-city capacity limit of 50 — otherwise false. Assigned at creation
                and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's
                lastName and postcode while carrying a different telephone, otherwise false.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                When possibleDuplicate is true, the id of the existing owner this owner may
                duplicate (same lastName and postcode, different telephone). Absent otherwise.
                Assigned at creation and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual risk review because any of the
                following hold: the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate),
                the email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares its second-level label
                with a known disposable domain, e.g. a sibling TLD such as
                'mailinator.net'), or the city is over its soft capacity
                (capacityWarning). Otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own
                fields and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table. Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality (region)
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Derived from the
                owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the stored telephone and returned;
                the raw telephone stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Present only when birthDate is set.
              type: string
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
                Derived from the owner's own fields and returned.
              type: string
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record. Deleted
                owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets

## Summary

I released version 2 of the owner identity across the four areas the spec called out.

**Version-2 identity derivation (V2 tag mixed in, region rederived inside identifiers)**
- `MemberId.java`: added a fixed `VERSION_TAG = "V2"` and a `regionV2(postcode, city)` that appends the tag to the plain region (`NSW` → `NSWV2`). The `memberId` now embeds `REGIONV2` instead of the plain region, so every `memberId` changes — and because the tag follows the region letters where v1 had a fiscal-year digit, no v1 `memberId` can recur. The plain `region(...)` is untouched.
- `OwnerIdentity.java`: mixed `V2|` into the hashed inputs of both `identityKey` (still a full 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex) and `householdId` (still deterministic per last-name+postcode), so both change while keeping their format and duplicate-detection semantics.
- `locality`, `timezone`, and the owner segment's derived region still go through the plain `region(...)`, so the V2 tag never leaks into user-facing region fields (Cp42/Cp17/Cp30/Cp55 stay green).

**Response shape** (`openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper.java`)
- Removed top-level `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey`; added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema grouping them under a nested `identity` object, plus a top-level integer `apiVersion: 2`. The mapper builds the nested `OwnerIdentityDto` and sets `apiVersion = 2`.

**Audit schema version 2** (`OwnerCreatedEvent.java` + doc in `AuditOwnerCreated.java`)
- Added `schemaVersion` (fixed at 2) to the structured event; it now serializes `{seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, schemaVersion:2, event:'OWNER_CREATED'}`, carrying the v2 `memberId` (Cp53).

Request fields are unchanged; the owner-segment rule is unchanged (recomputed from the v2 identity but still keyed on the plain region, verified by Cp55).
